name: deliver
description: One-writer delivery loop: plan, implement, independent review, supported fixes, and final verification.

chain.label: Plan the change
chain.task:
Create an implementation-ready plan for: {task}

Inspect repository instructions and the governing source, callers, tests, and configuration. Classify the work as a feature, bug, refactor, or mechanical change and scale the method accordingly. For a bug, identify expected versus observed behavior and the causal seam or name the missing reproduction evidence. For a refactor, state behavior and compatibility invariants. Define the smallest coherent change, explicit non-goals, global constraints, affected interfaces and paths, risks, cleanup behavior, and exact validation. Choose a focused failing regression or contract test when it has real evidence value; otherwise specify characterization coverage or the strongest relevant non-test validation. Do not edit files. Keep the plan compact.

chain.label: Implement and test

parallel.label: Correctness and runtime review
Tests, simplicity, and applicable security review

chain.label: Apply supported fixes
Verify final state
